pages.text: Route: fresh leaf -> withering tray -> rolling-table greening -> fermentation-vat fixation -> rolling table -> sieve-rack drying.$(br2)Oolong sits between fresh fragrance and body. Roll once more after the vat, then dry to finish it as oolong tea.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: Obtaining oolong completes the Half-Fermented Oolong advancement.
